articles.title: This mom didn’t just hike all 48 of N.H.’s 4,000-foot peaks. She did it along with her three young kids.
articles.description:
“They just love being outside,” said Whitney Pearson, who completed the 230-mile thru-hike with daughters Lydia, 6, Demi, 3, and Moriah, 1. “They talked about this hike for so long, they never asked to stop.”

The post This mom didn’t just hike all 48 of N.H.’s 4,000-foot peaks. She did it along with her three young kids. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Whitney Pearson completed a 230-mile hike with her three young daughters in New Hampshire.
The family hiked all 48 of New Hampshire's 4,000-foot peaks, inspiring local outdoor enthusiasts.
This achievement highlights family-friendly hiking opportunities for Boston residents seeking outdoor activities.
